applicant_utility.summary: AFLSP at Tsinghua is effectively a two-gate competition: you must first be admitted to a full-time international master's programme on the Beijing campus, and only pre-admitted students can be nominated by their department, so the portal application has to be finished months before the scholarship email deadline. BXAI caps the award at US$25,000 per year (US$50,000 in total) and Tsinghua describes it as tuition plus a living allowance that includes accommodation, books and materials - airfare, visas and insurance are never mentioned, so budget those separately. The pool is small (BXAI funds up to 100 scholars across ten partner universities), and the mandatory August summer programme and enrichment commitments mean service and intercultural leadership evidence, not grades alone, separate winners from nominees.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Asian nationals with a documented service and leadership record who are targeting a Beijing-based master's and can commit to compulsory summer enrichment programmes.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target programme sits at Tsinghua's Beijing campus - Shenzhen International Graduate School applicants are explicitly excluded
Finish the Tsinghua portal application (including the non-refundable RMB 800 fee) early, ahead of any department first-round cutoff, since AFLSP candidates are drawn only from pre-admitted students
Complete the AFLSP application form in English as a PDF with a working three-minute video link, and test the link before sending

Obtain colour scanner scans of original or notarised documents (phone photos and scans of copies are rejected), with transcripts stamped by your university and the recommendation letter on official letterhead
Email the pack to the target department's admissions/financial aid contact using the 'THU-Name-Material' file naming, well before the Beijing-time deadline
common_rejection_risks: Submitting only the portal application and never emailing the department - the scholarship file is then never opened at all
Holding another Tsinghua scholarship or third-party funding without disclosing it; dual awards are disqualifying and concealment voids the offer
Waiting for the admission result and missing the Beijing-time department deadline (the last published one was 1 March 2026 for the 2026 cohort)
Phone-camera scans, unstamped transcripts or mis-named files - Tsinghua states incomplete or non-conforming applications are not processed
Slipping below a 3.0 GPA on a 4.0/4.3 scale in year one, which lets BXAI withhold second-year disbursement
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Airfare to Beijing, student visa and residence-permit fees, insurance, and personal spending beyond the living allowance are not covered by the published scholarship terms.
document_audit: Colour scans made on a scanner only - images captured by mobile phone or camera, and scans of copies, are explicitly unacceptable
Transcripts must be stamped by the issuing university; if the transcript does not show a total GPA, a separate GPA certification document is also required
The AFLSP form must be written in English, submitted as a PDF, and must include the three-minute video link

The scholarship recommendation letter must be in English on official letterhead; the main admission application separately requires two academic recommendation letters from associate professors or senior professionals
Files must follow 'THU-Name-Material' naming with a number appended for repeat categories, or the pack may not be processed
alerts: As of 10 October 2026 the 2027 round has no published dates - the official page only says 'coming soon' and the 2026 cohort cycle closed in June 2026, so plan around the historical pattern (portal application September-February, scholarship email deadline early March) and re-check the official page
Deadlines run on Beijing time and department/programme application deadlines can be earlier than the February window; the scholarship pack goes to the department by email, not the central portal

Scholars must attend the BXAI Summer Program (up to three weeks in August) and all mandatory enrichment programmes in Beijing, and must notify BXAI of any exchange or overseas short-term study - disbursement can be withheld for programmes outside Asia
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Portal application plus fee first, then an email pack to the target department; the department shortlists pre-admitted students (by late March), Tsinghua's faculty committee nominates to BXAI (by end April), BXAI selects (by end May) and results reach nominees in June.
